note: Triennial election of Moira Rural District Council, 1955 (Co. Down county and rural poll day Thursday 2 June 1955). Only one candidate was nominated on Tuesday 17 May for each of the seven electoral divisions, so there was no contest; all were outgoing members (Lurgan Mail, 20 May 1955, p. 1). No party labels were printed. Returned unopposed.
